'''Teguar''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] sat at [[Akim's Munch/Legends|Akim's Munch]] when [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] attempted to consume a [[Gorg/Legends|Gorg]] from the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Gorgmonger/Legends|Gorgmonger]] [[Gragra/Legends|Gragra]].<ref name="Episode I" /> Teguar was known as a regulator for various deals.<ref name="TPMEVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
